name: Arc
description: Short lightning arcs snap between points the pointer has just passed through. Each arc is a crooked line with a hot white centre and a coloured glow around it, and the whole set is re-rolled many times a second so it crackles. Moving fast lights more arcs and brightens them, slowing down leaves one dim arc, and stopping puts them out. Clicking throws a fan of extra arcs out from the press point.
author: PlasmaZones

parameters.name: Arc count
parameters.description: How many arcs a fast-moving pointer lights at once

parameters.name: Reach
parameters.description: How far an arc may stretch from where it starts (px)

parameters.name: Jaggedness
parameters.description: How far each arc kinks away from a straight line, 0 for straight bolts

parameters.name: Crackle rate
parameters.description: How many times a second the arcs are re-rolled to new points

parameters.name: Click burst
parameters.description: How many extra arcs a click throws out from the press point, 0 to disable

parameters.name: Activation speed
parameters.description: Pointer speed below which no arcs are drawn (px per second), 0 to always draw them

parameters.name: Arc colour
parameters.description: Colour of the glow around each arc
